0.original: Serendipity has a new task for you.

1.original: Your next lesson requires that you craft three copper gorgets, for which you will need several copper ingots. Craft and deliver the gorgets to Serendipity.

2.original: Yet again your craftsmanship satisfies Serendipity, and yet again Gigi sees nothing worthy of praise. As a reward for your efforts, the guildmaster gives you a grinding wheel, which will aid you in your future goldsmithing endeavors.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※The next goldsmith quest will be available from Serendipity upon reaching level 10.

48.original: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I'm honestly a bit surprised to see you─most newcomers find Gigi's evaluations so harsh that we never hear from them again.

49.original: I'm so glad that you didn't take him seriously when he said your copper wasn't fit for a chamber pot. I mean, really, it doesn't even make sense─you could make a chamber pot out of <hex:021A020203>anything<hex:021A020103>!

50.original: Anyway, I hope you've been working hard, because your next task won't be nearly as easy as the last!

51.original: Listen well, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I want you to make me three copper gorgets.

52.original: For this, you'll need copper ingots, which you very conveniently learned to make last time.

53.original: Now, I directed you to purchase ore from Aistan before, but there are other ways to obtain it.

54.original: You could dig it up yourself, or perhaps befriend a lonely miner and convince him to share some with you.

55.original: However you choose to obtain your materials, I'm sure you'll put them to good use.

56.original: Are the gorgets ready yet, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Don't keep me waiting too long!

58.original: NE※GIGIGI★※...<hex:02100103>GoRgEtS...yOuR gOrGeTs ArE gOrGeOuS, gReEnHoRn. Oh WaIt, I mEaNt GrOtEsQuE. uNgOdLy. An AfFrOnT tO tHe GoDs ThEmSeLvEs. FoR sHaMe.

59.original: Beg your pardon, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I'm afraid that constructive criticism isn't one of Gigi's strong points.

60.original: But where was I? Ah, yes. Your gorgets are well made─strong and functional.

61.original: And that's the least they should be, as they're meant to protect one's throat.

62.original: When it comes to basic pieces like these, we don't have much creative freedom. Still, this doesn't mean we should put in less effort─especially since the techniques used to craft simple accessories are the same ones used to craft elaborate ones.

63.original: Now then, you've learned how to handle your hammer, but there's another tool I'd like you to get acquainted with.

64.original: With this grinding wheel, you'll find it easier to add the finishing touches when you craft. Try using it, and you'll see what I mean.

65.original: Keep your nose to that grinding wheel, and you'll be ready for your next challenge in no time at all.

67.original: A higher craftsmanship rating hastens the progress of synthesis; greater control increases the chance of creating high-quality items; and additional CP improves your crafting stamina.

68.original: Outfitting yourself with an eye to your current objective will increase the efficiency of your crafting endeavors.
